messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — metering pipeline detected token-count drift for prod tenant group 'alpha'. overage flags firing. auto-threshold at +12%. please ACK. :rotating_light:
oncall-jen: ACK. paging now. pulling dashboards and recent deploys.
sre-ash: I'm on it — checking kafka consumer lag and emitter heartbeats. any customer reports?
billing-sam: No inbound CS tickets yet. Billing alerting shows sudden delta in token counts vs. shadow ledger. current diff: +11.8% over 2h window.
eng-ml-liam: Noted. I just tried a quick query against token-aggregator v2: see tail of error log below 
```
2026-03-18T10:12:21Z ERROR emitter.go:237 failed ack: timeout
2026-03-18T10:13:05Z WARN tally_delta.go:89 unexpected increment: +0.00028 per event
2026-03-18T10:15:42Z INFO reconciler.go:401 reconcile run complete (latency 4.2s)
```
oncall-jen: ash — what are consumer lag numbers?
sre-ash: consumer lag is low. emitter group shows spiky retry count around 10:12-10:16 UTC. Kafka offsets look ok. suspect transient emitter retry inflation causing duplicate emits to metering.
billing-sam: If duplicates hit the aggregator before dedupe window expired we can get overcount. looking at windowing config: dedupe TTL = 5s for fast path, but aggregator has a burst backlog.
eng-ml-liam: changing dedupe TTL to 30s on a canary to see if counts align — canary target: shard-7. applying now: `kubectl patch deploy token-aggregator --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"canary":"shard-7"}}}}}'`
pm-kate: Heads-up: potential customer-visible overage flags. recommend temporary suppression of billing alerts while we validate.
oncall-jen: I can suppress alerts for 30m. who owns rollback if canary changes worsen state?
sre-ash: I'll monitor. if duplicate rate climbs >2x we rollback and enable hard dedupe via proxy.
billing-sam: Doing quick backfill recon between shadow and primary for last 3h to quantify impacted tokens. ETA ~18m.
eng-ml-liam: Canary applied. aggregator logs show reduced retry-window collisions on shard-7. preliminary diff dropping to +3% for that shard.
oncall-jen: alert suppression enabled for prod (30m). posting note to incident timeline. :white_check_mark:
pm-kate: Motion to notify top 3 customers on alpha group with a brief: "We detected transient metering inconsistency; counts may be inflated temporarily; no charges will be applied until reconciliation completes." Agree?
billing-sam: Agree. I'll draft copy and send via CX for approval.
sre-ash: consumer lag remains stable. emitter retry spikes have subsided. duplicate detection metrics show 92% dedupe success after TTL bump.
billing-sam: Backfill complete: shadow vs primary delta aggregated to ~+0.95% over 3h after canary. We'll run full-day reconciliation job overnight and hold customer billable writes until reconciled.
oncall-jen: Great. closing pager for now but keeping thread open for postmortem notes. If anything regresses, re-open.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status: mitigated (was: investigating). incident will be labeled "token-whisper" and assigned to eng-ml for RCA.
pm-kate: Thx team. please add steps for tests to prevent emitter retry amplification in runbook.
eng-ml-liam: Will own RCA + runbook tweak. planning: add synthetic load test, alert for retry-rate deltas, and increase dedupe window adaptive based on backlog.
billing-sam: I'll prepare a customer communication and keep billing hold until final reconciliation completed.
noncall-jen: Logged follow-ups in #postmortems. good work. :thumbsup:
